title: Why Mexico slapped 50% tariff on India, how it matters
description: Mexico is implementing significant tariff increases on imports from countries without free trade agreements, including India, China, and Vietnam, aiming to protect domestic industries and boost revenue. This move, potentially influenced by US trade pressures, could impact Indian auto exports and reshape global supply chains.

title: Rupee slips 24 paise to 90.56/USD, hits record low on US trade deadlock and outflows
description: The Indian rupee hit a new record low of 90.56 against the US dollar on Friday, depreciating by 24 paise. This decline was attributed to uncertainty surrounding the India-US trade deal and continuous foreign fund outflows, exacerbated by importers' aggressive dollar purchases amid rising precious metal prices.

title: Building India’s Financial Momentum
description: Over the last two days at the ETBFSI Converge Summit 2025, we brought together dozens of luminaries from the finance world, including Securities and Exchange Board of India chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey, banking veteran K.V. Kamath, and the CEOs of banks, NBFCs, insurance companies and tech firms. The idea was to discuss how they are preparing for India’s financial momentum, as macro indicators show strong signs of positivity. I nudged them on the realities as well, and they agreed that while big-ticket reforms are not happening yet, it is only a matter of time.

title: RBI may maintain repo rate at 5.25% through FY27: Fitch
description: Experts predict the Indian rupee will hover around 90 against the US dollar by the end of this year and 90.5 in 2026. Inflation is expected to rise to approximately 4% by mid-2026.

title: Rupee weakens as corporate dollar outflows eclipse Fed boost
description: The Indian rupee weakened today due to corporate dollar payments, overshadowing the Federal Reserve's rate cut.  Traders are watching for a potential trade deal with the U.S. and a significant Reserve Bank of India swap next week, which could influence the currency's trajectory amidst ongoing external sector challenges.

title: World Bank says China's economy stayed firm in third quarter as growth hit 5.2%
description: China's economy showed strength in the third quarter of 2025. Year-to-date GDP growth reached 5.2 percent. Full-year growth is projected at 4.9 percent. For 2026, the forecast is 4.4 percent. Government measures and stable trade policies are expected to boost investment and exports.

title: India’s FY26 growth aim goes up to 7.2% as tax cuts fuel demand: ADB
description: This upgrade is fueled by robust domestic consumption, supported by recent tax cuts. The Reserve Bank of India also increased its growth estimate. Strong manufacturing and services sectors are contributing to this positive outlook. Inflation is expected to ease.

title: ADB sharply revises upward India's GDP growth to 7.2pc for FY26
description: The Asian Development Bank has significantly upgraded India's FY26 growth forecast to 7.2%, driven by robust domestic consumption boosted by recent tax cuts. This upward revision also lifts Asia's growth projection. India's strong performance in the first half of FY26 is attributed to manufacturing and services expansion, alongside consumption and investment.

title: Rupee falls 10 paise to 90.15 against US dollar in early trade
description: The rupee depreciated 10 paise to 90.15 against the US dollar amid strong corporate and importer demand, with investors awaiting clarity from the US Federal Reserve. Market participants are in a wait-and-watch mode, anticipating the Fed's stance on interest rates and its potential impact on global currencies.

title: RBI’s 25 bps cut lifts sentiment, but India Inc's big investments still on hold, say CFOs
description: CFOs welcomed RBI’s rate cut but warned that private capex is still stuck in caution mode. While real estate players are confident that lower borrowing rates and stable demand will fuel new project launches, several other sectors remain unconvinced that the rate cut will trigger large-scale investments.

title: Explained: Will RBI’s $5 billion forex swap push the rupee lower?
description: The RBI’s $5-billion forex swap and Rs 1 lakh crore in bond purchases mark a major liquidity infusion aimed at reinforcing rate cuts and easing pressure on a weak rupee. While the move may trigger short-term softness in the currency, economists say it boosts credit flow and gives the RBI more flexibility to manage volatility amid weak inflows and heightened speculative positions.

title: RBI allows market forces to primarily dictate Rupee's value: Governor
description: During a post-Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) press briefing, Governor Malhotra addressed questions regarding the rupee's valuation and the RBI's approach to the exchange rate. He reiterated the central bank's consistent policy.

title: RBI MPC Dec Highlights: Durable liquidity support, Repo cut, external sector watch, Ombudsman campaign
description: Central Bank December MPC announces Rs 1 lakh crore of OMOs and a $5 billion dollar-rupee swap to support durable liquidity. Governor Sanjay Malhotra led RBI MPC upgraded GDP growth to 7.3%, projected softer inflation, flagged external sector risks, and launched a two-month campaign to clear RBI ombudsman grievances.

title: RBI projects 7.3% GDP growth for FY26 as domestic demand holds firm
description: Real GDP growth for 2025-26 is projected at 7.3 per cent, with Q3 at 7.0 per cent; and Q4 at 6.5 per cent. Real GDP growth for Q1:2026-27 is projected at 6.7 per cent and Q2 at 6.8 per cent.

title: RBI sees softer inflation ahead, cuts FY26 forecast to 2% as price pressures ease
description: The central bank expects inflation to average 0.6 per cent in Q3 and rise to 2.9 per cent in Q4 of 2025-26. For Q1 and Q2 of 2026-27, CPI inflation has been projected at 3.9 per cent and 4.0 per cent, respectively.

title: RBI MPC cuts repo rate by 25 bps to 5.25%; retains neutral stance
description: The Reserve Bank of India on Friday reduced the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25% in its December meet, marking a calibrated continuation of the easing cycle after delivering 100 basis points of rate cuts earlier this year.

title: Rupee likely to inch up ahead of RBI decision after recovery tempers bearish run
description: Today, the Indian rupee is set to open on a slightly stronger note, fueled by recent gains that have mitigated its previous downward trend. As investors gear up for the Reserve Bank of India's pivotal interest rate decision, all eyes are on the central bank's forthcoming statement and press briefing.

title: GDP surge versus Rupee fall
description: The central issue is whether the 8.2% number represents sustainable expansion or merely a temporary quarterly surge. GDP, by design, measures total output; it does not reveal who gains and who is excluded. Also, interpreting aggregate consumption patterns for a diverse nation is far more complex.My view remains that this pace is unsustainable.

title: India needs transparent GDP methods, robust surveys to reflect true state of economy: Report
description: India should adopt transparent methodologies, robust surveys, and simultaneous index updates in GDP calculations to accurately assess the true state of the economy, highlighted a report by Systematix Research.

title: Rupee breach of 90 against dollar set to trigger price hikes across consumer goods sector
description: Rupee's slide past 90 against the dollar is forcing consumer electronics, beauty, and car companies to consider price hikes, potentially negating recent sales gains from GST cuts. Companies heavily reliant on imports are planning increases of 3-7% due to rising component costs and a weaker rupee, with some hikes expected this month or next.

title: CII calls for higher public capex, investment push to sustain growth
description: The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) has urged the government to prioritize investments for sustained economic growth, recommending a 12% increase in central capital expenditure and a 10% rise in state capex for FY27.

title: India's wholesale prices fall 0.32% in November vs 1.21% contraction in October
description: India's wholesale price inflation turned negative in November, contracting by 0.32% year-on-year. This decline was primarily attributed to falling prices in food, mineral oils, and crude petroleum & natural gas. While food inflation eased, prices for minerals and food articles saw month-on-month increases.

title: INDIA RUPEE-Rupee falls past 91 on hedging demand, outflows as US trade stalemate drags
description: INDIA-MARKETS/RUPEE (UPDATE 1)INDIA RUPEE-Rupee falls past 91 on hedging demand, outflows as US trade stalemate drags

title: Rupee breaches 91-Mark amid foreign outflows, Experts say volatility to continue till January
description: The Indian rupee touched a historic low on Tuesday, breaching the 91-mark against the US dollar for the first time. The sharp fall highlights growing pressure on the domestic currency amid continued foreign fund outflows and weak capital inflows.

title: RBI should let rupee move and avoid defending any level: Neelkanth Mishra
description: Indian rupee breached 91 to the dollar at its lowest level, Axis Bank Chief Economist Neelkanth Mishra said there was no fundamental cause for panic and that it would be much wiser for the RBI to not be seen as holding a level, a mistake he said was earlier made around 83 to the dollar. With strong reserves, manageable external balances and a 3-5 year phase of global competitive currency debasement ahead, he said allowing the rupee to move is more sustainable.
